claude.sample_unit: individuals at ultra-high risk of psychosis

links.outcome: Calibration, discrimination, and net benefit of updated versus original psychosis prediction models over time
links.effect: All 3 updating methods improved performance vs original (recalibration p=.009; refitting p=.020; dynamic updating p=.001). Dynamic updating best: C-index 0.71, calibration slope 1.12.
links.quote: All 3 updating methods improved the predictive performance compared with the original model (recalibration: p = .009; refitting: p = .020; dynamic updating: p = .001).

links.outcome: Temporal deterioration of static model calibration over the validation period
links.effect: The original static model was poorly calibrated over the entire validation period.
links.quote: The original model was poorly calibrated over the entire validation period.

unlisted_practices: Bayesian dynamic updating of prediction models to mitigate temporal performance decline
